title: LLM-Telemetry-Proxy
description: A lightweight, zero-intrusive reverse proxy and full control dashboard for LLM workflows. Passively measures TTFB, generation speed, token counts, and cost metrics with real-time payload inspection and rate guards.
highlights: Zero-intrusive reverse proxy architecture with near-zero latency overhead
Real-time token analytics, streaming chunk inspection, and date-aware cost tracking
24-hour token budget supervisor and concurrency queuing to prevent 429 errors
